run_cpu_limit_hook: run the CpuLimit hook to restrict a benchmark job to specific CPUs using a hex mask
create_cpu_mask: create a hex string CPU mask to enable or disable specific CPUs for a benchmark process
test_before_job: test the before_job method to validate a hex CPU mask and prepend taskset to job args
review_cpulimit_class: review the CpuLimit class that extends Hook to limit benchmarks to a subset of CPUs
refactor_before_job: refactor the before_job method to support additional CPU mask formats beyond hex strings
